# Dota Insights tools

<!-- generated by scripts/build_skill.py from the server's tools; do not edit by hand -->

Required arguments are listed; every tool also takes optional ones (most take `filters`).
The server's own tool descriptions have the full parameter docs.

## analysis

| Tool | Purpose | Required | Example question |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `analyze_correlation` | How strongly a metric (GPM, wards, stacks...) is associated with winning, with match duration controlled for: games are split into duration strata and, within each, into players above vs at-or-below the stratum's median. | `metric` | Does stacking more camps actually help supports win? |
| `explore_query` | Ad-hoc question the other tools do not cover? | `table` | Average GPM by lane role in league matches this patch? |
| `find_matches` | Find concrete matches by heroes (allies and enemies), outcome, rank, duration, patch and net-worth swing (e.g. | — | Show me matches won after being 20k gold behind. |
| `test_hypothesis` | Compare two groups of a hero's matches defined by structured conditions (item timing, side, lane, GPM, duration...) and test whether their win rate or a metric differs. | `hero`, `group_a` | Do Phantom Assassins with BKB before 20 minutes win more? |

## builds

| Tool | Purpose | Required | Example question |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `get_ability_stats` | Skill priority, talents and Aghanim's upgrades of a hero in the current patch. | `hero` | Which talents do Invoker players take at 10 and 15? |
| `get_hero_builds` | Item and skill build of a hero in the current patch. | `hero` | What should I build on Juggernaut this patch? |
| `get_neutral_items` | Neutral item usage by tier with win rates, and the best neutral items for a hero. | — | Which tier 3 neutral item is best on Sniper? |

## charts

| Tool | Purpose | Required | Example question |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `render_chart` | Draw a line, bar or heatmap chart of numbers from this server's tools. | `data` | Draw Anti-Mage's gold curve as a chart. |

## economy

| Tool | Purpose | Required | Example question |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `analyze_death` | Cost of dying: gold lost and respawn time by game minute, how much the team's gold lead moves in the minutes after a death, and when buying back goes with winning (by phase and gold lead). | — | How much does dying at 25 minutes cost, and when is buyback worth it? |
| `get_comeback_stats` | Chance to win when behind by a gold deficit at a minute, a grid over minutes and deficits, factors that go with comebacks (next Roshan, tower, Tormentor) and the heroes whose teams come back most. | — | How often do teams win from 10k behind at 25 minutes? |
| `get_farm_distribution` | Share of team gold held by positions 1-5, in wins vs losses, and which carry share / core share goes with winning. | — | How much of the team's net worth should the carry have? |
| `get_objective_impact` | Win rate of the team that gets first blood, the first tower, first Roshan (Aegis), both of the first two Roshans, the first Tormentor, the first barracks, and more power / bounty / wisdom runes, with its gold lead at the time and its win rate when the game was even. | — | How much does killing the first Roshan raise the win rate? |

## farming

| Tool | Purpose | Required | Example question |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `get_farming_stats` | Gold, GPM, XP, XPM and last hits of a hero at given minutes (median and quartiles). | `hero` | How much gold does a Medusa have at 20 minutes? |
| `get_gold_xp_curves` | Minute-by-minute median gold and XP of several heroes, in won and lost matches side by side. | `heroes` | Who out-farms whom between Alchemist and Naga Siren? |
| `get_hero_benchmarks` | Percentiles (p10..p99) of a hero's GPM, XPM, last hits/min, hero damage/min and more, and which percentile given values fall at. | `hero` | Is 600 GPM good for an Anti-Mage? |
| `get_hero_lane_stats` | How a hero's laning phase goes: lane win/draw/loss rates, farm at 10 minutes, and the lane opponents and lane partners it does best and worst with. | `hero` | How often does Viper win its lane? |
| `get_hero_power_curve` | Win rate by match duration (5-minute buckets), the duration where the hero wins most, and whether it is an early-game or late-game hero. | `hero` | Does Spectre win more in long games? |

## feedback

| Tool | Purpose | Required | Example question |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `report_wrong_answer` | Report to the server's maintainer that a tool's answer was wrong, for instance when the user points out a number that contradicts the game or another trusted site. | `tool_name`, `what_was_wrong` | That win rate is wrong, Dotabuff shows something else. Report it. |
| `suggest_feature` | Record a Dota 2 question that no tool on this server can answer, so it can be considered for a new tool. | `question` | Can you tell me my exact MMR? (no tool can, so the question is logged) |

## general

| Tool | Purpose | Required | Example question |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `get_general_stats` | Game-wide numbers for recent public matches: Radiant vs Dire win rate, match duration distribution, region shares and game-mode shares, with sample sizes. | — | Does Radiant win more than Dire? |
| `get_rank_distribution` | Share of players at each rank medal (Herald to Immortal) and star, with the percentile at the top of each medal, from OpenDota and STRATZ, plus the size of the current-season Immortal leaderboard per region (STRATZ). | — | What share of players are Divine or higher? |
| `get_records` | Single-match records (most kills, highest GPM, longest match, ...) from OpenDota's top-100 lists, optionally only those set on one hero. | — | What is the highest GPM ever recorded on Alchemist? |

## heroes

| Tool | Purpose | Required | Example question |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `compare_heroes` | Side-by-side win rate, pick rate, KDA, XPM, net worth and last hits for 2-5 heroes, with deltas against the first hero and pairwise win-rate significance tests. | `heroes` | Pudge or Lion as a 4 in Legend? |
| `find_hidden_gems` | Rarely picked heroes that win more than average, after shrinking small samples towards the average. | — | Which rarely picked heroes win a lot right now? |
| `get_hero_overview` | Win and pick rate of one hero with 95% intervals, its win-rate rank, which positions it is played in, win rate per medal (Herald to Immortal), the trend over the last three patches, and pro pick/ban rates. | `hero` | How strong is Phantom Assassin right now in Ancient? |
| `get_tier_list` | Heroes ranked by sample-size-adjusted win rate and sorted into S, A, B, C and D tiers. | — | Which carries are the strongest this patch? |

## items

| Tool | Purpose | Required | Example question |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `analyze_item` | Whether an item's effectiveness depends on when it is bought, and where it works best. | `item` | Is an early BKB worth it on Faceless Void? |
| `compare_items` | Compare alternative items on one hero within the same purchase-time buckets. | `items`, `hero` | Battle Fury or Maelstrom first on Troll Warlord? |
| `get_item_overview` | How often an item is bought, by which heroes, when, and win rate by purchase time. | `item` | Who buys Radiance and when? |
| `get_item_payback` | Extra gold per minute after buying a farming item, and how long it takes to pay back. | `items` | How long does Hand of Midas take to pay for itself? |

## live

| Tool | Purpose | Required | Example question |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `predict_live_win` | Win probability for each side of a live game (or a described game state) from the net-worth lead, the game time and the draft, with the model's calibration. | — | Who is likely to win a game with a 5k lead at 30 minutes? |

## matches

| Tool | Purpose | Required | Example question |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `analyze_laning_phase` | Laning phase of a match: last hits, denies, gold and XP at 10:00 per player, lane assignments, who won each lane, and kills before 10:00 with a rotation flag. | `match_id` | Who won each lane in match 8012345678? |
| `analyze_match` | Overview of one match: result, duration, draft, every player's KDA, GPM, XPM, net worth, damage and healing, the biggest contributors by a documented score, the largest gold leads of each side and whether the winner came back from a deficit. | `match_id` | What happened in match 8012345678? |
| `analyze_teamfights` | Every teamfight of a match: time, participants, deaths per side, gold and XP swing, which side won it, and each participant's damage, healing, kills, deaths and buybacks; plus each player's stun time over the match. | `match_id` | Which teamfights did we lose and why? |
| `analyze_vision` | Observer and sentry wards per player and team: placed, destroyed by the enemy, average lifetime, dewards, and each player's difference from the match average. | `match_id` | Who warded the most and how many wards were dewarded? |
| `find_turning_points` | The largest gold-advantage swings of a match over short windows, each linked to the teamfights and objectives (towers, barracks, Roshan, Tormentor, buybacks) around it. | `match_id` | Which fight decided match 8012345678? |
| `get_match_timeline` | Per-minute gold and XP advantage, key events (first blood, towers, barracks, Roshan, aegis, Tormentor, buybacks) and each player's item purchases by time. | `match_id` | When did the gold lead flip in my last game? |

## matchups

| Tool | Purpose | Required | Example question |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `analyze_draft` | Per-hero and pairwise matchup/synergy contributions of a draft, a heuristic Radiant win estimate, and weaknesses visible in the data (counters, poor pairs, uncovered positions, missing Disabler/Initiator tags). | `radiant`, `dire` | Which side has the better draft? |
| `find_hero_combos` | Best ally duos or trios by synergy advantage, with per-pair sample thresholds. | — | Which support pairs best with Chaos Knight? |
| `get_hero_matchups` | Win rate and matchup advantage of a hero against and alongside every other hero. | `hero` | What counters Huskar? |
| `suggest_pick` | Rank heroes for the open slot by matchups against enemies and synergy with allies. | `allies`, `enemies` | We have Axe and Lion against Sniper and Drow; what should I pick mid? |

## players

| Tool | Purpose | Required | Example question |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `compare_players` | Two players side by side: overall win rate and averages, then the heroes both play and each position they play. | `player_a`, `player_b` | How do I compare with my friend on the heroes we both play? |
| `find_player_weaknesses` | Where a player falls short: per-minute stats below their medal's percentiles, the game phase (10/20/30 min net worth and XP) where losses fall behind wins, and traits more common in lost matches. | `player` | Where am I below my rank's average? |
| `get_player_hero_pool` | Matches and win rate per hero, compared with that hero's win rate and OpenDota benchmarks (GPM, XPM, last hits, damage percentiles) at the player's medal, and the heroes where the player over- or under-performs. | `player` | Which of my heroes win more than average? |
| `get_player_peers` | The player's most frequent teammates and opponents over recent matches, with the player's win rate with or against each. | `player` | Who do I win the most with? |
| `get_player_profile` | A player's medal, leaderboard rank, total matches, overall win rate and a summary of their last 20 matches. | `player` | What is the medal and recent form of account 56939869? |
| `get_player_stats` | Average KDA, kills, deaths, assists, GPM, XPM, last hits, hero/tower damage and win rate over a player's recent matches, with 95% intervals. | `player` | What are my average KDA and GPM over the last 100 games? |
| `get_player_trends` | How a player's win rate, KDA, GPM, XPM, last hits and damage change over their recent matches, plus longest and current win/loss streaks. | `player` | Am I improving over my last 200 matches? |

## pro

| Tool | Purpose | Required | Example question |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `get_head_to_head` | Past league meetings between two teams: overall record, by league, and drafts. | `team_a`, `team_b` | What is the record between OG and Tundra? |
| `get_live_matches` | Top live games now: teams, players, game time, score and net-worth lead. | — | Which pro games are live right now? |
| `get_pro_builds` | Items and skill builds pros use on a hero, next to public-match builds. | `hero` | How do pros build Morphling compared with pubs? |
| `get_pro_matches` | Recent professional (league) matches: teams, league, winner, score, duration, draft. | — | What were Team Spirit's latest results? |
| `get_pro_player` | A pro player's team, signature heroes and results by position in league matches. | `player` | What does Yatoro play and how does he do? |
| `get_team_stats` | A pro team's win rate, average duration, hero pool and draft tendencies. | `team` | Which heroes does Gaimin Gladiators draft most? |
| `get_tournament_stats` | Hero picks, bans, contest rate and win rates in a tournament, with match records. | `league` | Which heroes were contested most at The International? |

## reference

| Tool | Purpose | Required | Example question |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `lookup_reference` | Look up a hero, item or ability: names, attributes and roles, abilities and talents, item cost and components, ability behaviour and damage type, and the patch the reference data is from. | `query` | What does Faceless Void's Chronosphere do? |

## trends

| Tool | Purpose | Required | Example question |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `find_meta_trends` | Find heroes whose win rate or pick rate changed between two patches or two periods. | — | Which heroes rose the most after the last patch? |
| `get_hero_patch_history` | A hero's win rate and pick rate per patch, with intervals and the biggest jumps. | `hero` | How has Pudge's win rate changed over the patches? |
| `get_patch_summary` | What changed in a patch: release dates and the heroes whose win or pick rate moved most compared with the previous patch, with STRATZ patch notes when it has them. | — | What changed for heroes in 7.39? |
